youtube.baslik: How much sound in the ear canal reaches the middle ear? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In wideband immittance, the proportion of power that passes into the middle ear is called absorbance; absorbance is one minus energy reflectance. In a normal adult ear, absorbance is low at low frequencies, where most of the sound is reflected, and reaches its highest values between 1 and 4 kilohertz. When there is fluid in the middle ear, absorbance is clearly low at almost all frequencies.
